title: Add SITE_MAX_RETRIES constant
exact_code:
# Extra attempts for a site whose check comes back as an error (timeout,
# selector not found, unhandled exception) before giving up on it. Each
# attempt gets a fresh browser context, since a stale page/context is often
# the actual cause of a fluke, not the site itself.
SITE_MAX_RETRIES = 2
description: A module-level constant controlling how many extra attempts a flaky site check gets before its result is accepted as a final error.
acceptance_criteria: A top-level constant named SITE_MAX_RETRIES is defined with integer value 2
It is placed among the other top-level path/config constants, not inside any function
